title: Three Words, No New Pieces
label: ch:bn-three-words-no-new-pieces
canDo: I can read চা, জল and দুধ off the page without learning a single new shape, and say why a reading chapter that adds nothing is still worth its place.

payoff.summary: Milk puts the plain dental and its breathy partner side by side in one three-piece word, then the chapter's three words are read back — every one of them paid for by consonants bought several chapters earlier.
